text: 2026年下半年以来，恒生科技指数领跑全球股市，与此同时，南向资金持续加码港股市场。数据显示，截至9月11日，南向资金7月以来合计净买入近千亿港元，其中，科技龙头与红利资产成为资金追捧的焦点。多家机构认为，从估值水平来看，港股性价比依然突出，在当前较为震荡的市场环境中，科技和红利两类资产具有显著的配置价值。（上海证券报）
text_en: Since the second half of 2026, the Hang Seng Tech Index has led global stock markets, while southbound capital has continued to increase its allocation to the Hong Kong stock market. Data shows that as of September 11, southbound capital had recorded total net buying of nearly HK$100 billion since July, with technology leaders and dividend assets becoming the focus of capital pursuit. Multiple institutions believe that from a valuation perspective, Hong Kong stocks remain highly cost-effective, and in the current relatively volatile market environment, technology and dividend assets have significant allocation value. (Shanghai Securities News)
